about: Prompts with the MatchAwards tools a model should pick (expect), for manual precision and recall checks against a dev build. direct: one tool is plainly asked for. indirect: the need is implied. negative: no MatchAwards tool should be called. Follow-up prompts assume an earlier search in the same chat.
